Purpose: Define what the agent is allowed to screen for
Main agent action: Capture case objective, market scope, restructuring / shell-acquisition constraints and delivery boundary
ER/BRB role: No scoring yet; sets rule boundary
PCE / governance role: Later checks whether outputs exceed mandate

Purpose: Define trusted sources and retrieval discipline
Main agent action: Use HKEX / market snapshot / announcements / filings / cached structured sources
ER/BRB role: Source reliability becomes input to later ER/BRB belief weights
PCE / governance role: Checks source legitimacy and whether claims rely on permitted sources

Purpose: Build the candidate universe before filtering
Main agent action: Create HK-listed universe and structured market snapshot
ER/BRB role: Not the main scoring point; prepares candidate facts
PCE / governance role: Checks universe is traceable and sufficiently complete

Purpose: Turn raw sources into comparable fields
Main agent action: Normalize market cap, P/B, turnover, listing status, company fields and evidence tables

Purpose: Remove clearly unsuitable names while preserving uncertain candidates for DD
Main agent action: Apply hard filters and produce pass / exclude / watchlist / DD escalation
ER/BRB role: HF-ER/BRB fuses noisy preliminary evidence into filter decision + confidence; hard exclusion gates remain binding
PCE / governance role: Checks every retain/exclude has rule, source, rationale and uncertainty handling

Purpose: Define which companies proceed into DD / shortlist analysis
Main agent action: Carry forward pass and watchlist candidates; preserve escalation reasons
ER/BRB role: Uses HF-ER/BRB escalation outputs to prioritize DD

Purpose: Assess deal feasibility and hidden blockers
Main agent action: Review control path, debt/litigation, compliance, announcements, carrying cost, Rule 14 / transaction risks
ER/BRB role: DD-ER/BRB aggregates deeper document-level evidence; can refine or overturn HF-stage provisional judgments
PCE / governance role: Checks material claims have evidence; high risks trigger escalation/human review

Purpose: Turn DD-backed findings into proposed shortlist/recommendation
Main agent action: Generate case study draft, final report draft and recommendation narrative
ER/BRB role: DD-ER/BRB affects reranking and recommendation strength
PCE / governance role: Checks recommendation is still only a Proposal before certification

Main agent action: Link mandate, sources, retrieval, universe, filters, ER/BRB, DD, calculations, claims and review status
ER/BRB role: Both HF-ER/BRB and DD-ER/BRB must be trace-linked
PCE / governance role: Checks for broken evidence chains or unsupported claims

Purpose: External gate: generation does not equal permission
Main agent action: Certifier checks full trace and claim-level audit before release
ER/BRB role: Does not replace business judgment; certifies the ER/BRB-supported trace is auditable
PCE / governance role: Outputs Certified / DD Issues / Revision / Human Escalation / Rejected

Main agent action: Deliver final certificate, report/case study, DD pack and audit workbook
PCE / governance role: Checks final report does not bypass certification
